content:
The Kotlin Toolchain helps you build and ship multiplatform apps faster, with less setup and configuration. Its CLI provides a unified workflow for building, running, testing, and publishing apps for Android, iOS, desktop, and web, whether you’re developing with AI agents or writing code yourself.

Kotlin Toolchain 0.14 makes it easier to publish iOS apps to TestFlight and brings improvements to agentic development workflows, along with several other enhancements.

Install Kotlin Toolchain

Or try this prompt in your favorite agent: 

Create a new Kotlin Multiplatform app for Android, iOS, desktop, and web with the Kotlin Toolchain CLI (https://kotlin-toolchain.org/latest).

To access the latest Kotlin Toolchain features from your IDE, use IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.4 (or newer) or Android Studio Rabbit 1 | 2026.2.1 (or newer). Make sure the latest version of the Kotlin Toolchain plugin is installed.

iOS application publishing

You can now publish iOS apps using the kotlin publish testflight command.
This launches an easy publishing flow that guides you through most of the setup and steps required to publish a new application to TestFlight for the first time. After the first publication, you can publish updates automatically using the same command.

The command will ask for an App Store Connect access token (Apple Developer Program membership is required, as usual), which is a standard way to authorize automations to publish applications in App Store Connect. We never save the private key itself or ask for Apple ID credentials.

Note that you can also still access an Xcode project and use that to set up publishing with manual signing and other advanced options, if necessary.

For more information see the documentation.

Agentic workflows support

The Kotlin CLI wizard now helps configure agents by generating relevant files in your project, such as MCP server configuration and an AGENTS.md file. These files provide general recommendations for agents to help them act more accurately and reduce the development feedback loop.

We also added Kotlin Toolchain skills as part of the Kotlin agent skills collection.

To install the skills, run in your terminal:

npx skills add kotlin/kotlin-agent-skills

Our AI evals show that using these skills helps to reduce the token consumption of working with Kotlin Toolchain-based projects.

Error and warning visibility in templates in the IDE

Now, when a module has errors or warnings originating from the template application, the IDE displays the problem both at its source and the template application.

If a template issue only arises upon application (e.g., via module dependency conflicts), the template message includes a hint specifying when it occurs.

Java 8+ API desugaring for Android

Android’s core library desugaring is now supported natively by the Kotlin Toolchain: a single desugaring: enabled line in module.yaml turns it on, with the desugaring library itself overridable via the library option. See the settings reference for more details.

Customizable external tool download URLs

The Kotlin Toolchain downloads the external tools it needs under the hood, and every location it downloads from is now documented and overridable with an environment variable. This makes it possible to route all downloads through internal mirrors, whether to comply with corporate network policies or to avoid Maven Central’s rate limits.

Dependency resolution optimization

The first import of a project – the one where every dependency has to be resolved and downloaded from the network – just got significantly faster. According to our benchmarks, importing the Kotlin Toolchain project itself without caches is now more than 3x faster. The updated resolver makes fewer unnecessary requests to repositories, downloads more dependencies in parallel, and still ensures that all downloaded files are valid.

Install Kotlin Toolchain 0.14.0

Ready to start building with the Kotlin Toolchain?

Check out our Getting started guide to dive into code examples, tutorials, or explore the comprehensive user guide to learn more.

Install Kotlin Toolchain

Or try this prompt in your favorite agent: 

Create a new Kotlin Multiplatform app for Android, iOS, desktop, and web with the Kotlin Toolchain CLI (https://kotlin-toolchain.org/latest).
